card.name: Toxicity words before cause-like wording
card.fires_on: Words about toxicity or adverse effects (toxic, toxicity, TOXIC, -itis) and linking words like which or may right where a cause or result phrase could follow. Seen mostly in warnings and adverse reaction text.

modes.label: Toxic word pieces
modes.description: The word toxic, or part of toxicity, in overdose and warning text.
modes.example: intensification of mental symptoms or<< toxic>> psychosis in patients with mental illness being treated

modes.label: Adverse event onset
modes.description: Words like toxicity, itis, or may that come just before occurred or occur.
modes.example: dermatologic<< toxicity>> occurred in 90% including Grade

modes.label: Linking word
modes.description: A word like which after a noun about difficulties, where a clause on what happened follows.
modes.example: detailing the difficulties<< which>> he encountered from his want of knowing various

card.writes: It lowers words like caused, induced and their Chinese equivalents, so the next word is not a cause phrase.
card.plain: It fires on toxicity and adverse-reaction wording just before the text says what occurred.
